Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StrataTek initial COI + claims summary

Hi Mateo / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding intake call earlier. As promised, attaching our Certificate of Insurance and a consolidated claims summary covering 2019—2025. The COI shows general liability, commercial auto, and professional liability limits; carrier is Meridian Mutual (AM Best A-).

Attachments (stubs):
- StrataTek-COI-2026-06-07.pdf (COI stub)
- StrataTek-Claims-Summary-2019-2025.xlsx (summary spreadsheet)
- StrataTek-W9.pdf (tax form)

A few notes up front: we have one subcontractor we sometimes engage for site installs (name: FieldOps LLC) and we can provide their COI on request. The claims sheet has two small slip-and-fall incidents in 2023 (both under $10k, closed).

Let me know if anything is missing or if you prefer the additional insured endorsement wording be submitted on our broker letterhead. Happy to run through anything with procurement.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Operations Lead | StrataTek, Inc.
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@stratatek.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StrataTek initial COI + claims summary

Hi Nina — thanks for sending these over and for the clear claims table. A few items procurement needs to confirm before we can finalize vendor activation and issue a PO: 

- COI must name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured with Primary and Non-Contributory language and a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Policy limits: GL $5M aggregate preferred; if lower, please confirm and provide rationale.
- Effective / Expiration dates must cover the initial 12-month term of our engagement (we'll confirm contract start, but please ensure no imminent lapse).
- Carrier AM Best rating noted — please include broker contact and policy numbers on the endorsement if possible.
- Subcontractor disclosure: please confirm whether FieldOps LLC will be used on Redwood work and, if so, either add them to your COI or provide their COI and proof of their workers' comp coverage.
- Claims: thanks for the summary. For our risk review we need brief narratives for any liability claims > $5k. I see two closed incidents in 2023 — can you add one-sentence descriptions and amounts for those rows?
- W-9 receipt confirmed; procurement will need vendor banking details for ACH setup later (we will provide a secure link).

Operational ask: Please upload the final COI + signed Additional Insured endorsement (or broker-signed endorsement language) to our vendor portal: https://redwood-procurement.internal/uploads/portal/STRATA-4931 — we can provisionally reserve a PO once we have the endorsement language and claim narratives.

If it's easier, your broker can send the endorsement directly to kimberly_park@redwood.com. We aim to create a conditional PO by EOD Wed (2026-06-09) and finalize payment terms after endorsement receipt.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
Phone: (650) 555-0102

- Claims detail: the two 2023 incidents were
  * 2023-03-18: customer slip during on-site install — amount paid: $7,850 — closed, no ongoing exposure.
  * 2023-09-02: minor equipment handling claim — amount paid: $4,200 — closed.
  Per your threshold, only the first exceeds $5k — I added a 2-line narrative in the claims spreadsheet.
- FieldOps LLC is engaged occasionally; their COI is not included yet. We can either add FieldOps as a named insured on Redwood projects or upload their COI by Thu 2026-06-10.

Attachments (stubs):
- StrataTek-COI-with-endorsement-draft.pdf

Question: do you require a broker-signed hard copy of the endorsement, or is a broker-signed PDF sufficient for procurement? If needed we can request a DocuSign envelope from our broker.

Thanks,
Nina

Subject: PO reservation & next steps — StrataTek onboarding

Nina — thanks for the quick turnaround and for adding the claims narratives. We've reviewed the draft endorsement and preliminary COI. A few closing items before procurement issues the conditional PO: 

1) We can accept a broker-signed PDF endorsement. Please have your broker email the endorsement to kimberly_park@redwood.com with their broker contact info.
2) Please upload FieldOps LLC's COI by EOD Thu 2026-06-10 or confirm they will not perform Redwood work; if they will, we need their workers' comp on file.
3) Once we receive the signed endorsement and the FieldOps COI (if applicable), procurement will create PO STR-2026-0597 (conditional) and email the PO to your billing contact.

For invoicing: please invoice against PO STR-2026-0597 and include the PO number on all invoices. Our ACH enrollment link will be sent separately after vendor banking is validated.

Appreciate the responsiveness — we look forward to getting you enabled.

Best,
